title.narrative: Programa de Mejoramiento y Expansin de la Red Vial
Road Network Upgrade and Expansion Program

description.narrative: El objetivo general del Programa es mejorar la movilidad y la seguridad al reducir los costos de operacin de vehculos, los tiempos de viaje y accidentes de trfico. Este objetivo se lograr a travs de la actualizacin, mejora y ampliacin de la red de carreteras. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) rehabilitar, mejorar, ampliar y construir carreteras, calles, aceras y carriles bici, (ii) mejorar la seguridad vial, (iii) fortalecer la capacidad institucional del organismo ejecutor, y (iv) proporcionar el mantenimiento de las carreteras

The general objective of the Program is to enhance mobility and safety by reducing vehicle operating costs, travel times and road fatalities. This objective will be achieved through the upgrade, improvement and expansion of the road network. The specific objectives are to: (i) rehabilitate, improve, expand and construct roads, streets, sidewalks and bikeways; (ii) improve the road safety; (iii) strengthen the institutional capacity of the Executing Agency; and (iv) provide for the maintenance of the roads.
